decision.reason: A strictly positive improvement over the frozen Stage 1 winner whose paired 95% interval excludes zero at all 4 non-degenerate capacities, at least 20% of the original Stage 0 oracle gap closed at [12, 16, 24, 32], and no capacity regressing above the 3% threshold.

stage2_criteria.note: Stage 2's criteria applied verbatim to the Stage 3 primary variant.

criteria.note: The STRONG and VERY_STRONG rungs are byte-identical to Stage 2 so the three stages remain directly comparable. Stage 2's ladder had no rung between a 10% cost win and failure, which the Stage 2 calibration evidence showed is a wide gap: Condition A is roughly twice as hard as Condition B at every capacity. The PARTIAL rung below was added before any Stage 3 evaluation was run and no threshold was moved to accommodate a measured result.

no_go.rule: any suite-level capacity with C_Stage3 > 1.03 * C_Stage1, or fewer than three non-degenerate capacities with a strictly positive improvement whose paired 95% interval excludes zero

criteria.precedence: NO_GO first; then VERY_STRONG_SUCCESS; then STRONG_SUCCESS; then PARTIAL_SUCCESS; then WEAK; otherwise NO_GO
